name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project in the Salta Province of northwestern Argentina. The project is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study (June 2026), hosting Proven and Probable Reserves of 184 Moz silver and 1.8 Moz gold, with an after-tax NPV of approximately US$3 billion. The company is targeting first production in 2029.
